layout.label: Display Odds Ratios Exp(B) with 95% Confidence Intervals

r_template:
local({
  fmla <- as.formula(paste('as.factor({{escapeR dep_var}}) ~', paste(c({{#each covariates}}'{{escapeR this}}',{{/each}} NULL), collapse = ' + ')))
  fit <- glm(fmla, data = .active_data, family = binomial())
  res_tidy <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = {{chk_exp}}, exponentiate = {{chk_exp}})
  rrad_emit_table(res_tidy, title = 'Logistic Regression Parameter Estimates')
  rrad_emit_table(broom::glance(fit), title = 'Model Summary (AIC and Log-Likelihood)')
})
